messages:
Jake (Support): Heads up — Nexera staging started seeing repeated 429s and embed timeouts around 03:10 UTC. Customer reports UI errors during onboarding checks, marking this as a renewal-risk signal from support. Logs below.

Jake (Support): ```error
2026-03-22T03:10:12Z service=embed-worker status=429 msg=rate_limited tenant=nexera shard=3
2026-03-22T03:12:01Z service=embed-worker status=504 msg=upstream_timeout tenant=nexera
```

alert-bot: Incident created INC-8792 (severity: high) — threshold breach for embed failures on tenant nexera. See /incidents/INC-8792

Lia - CSM: Thanks for flagging — I'm looping in CS Ops. Lia here, I'll own customer comms. Can you confirm whether this is only staging or also affecting prod?

Jake (Support): Confirmed only staging environment so far, but failure rate ~18% over the last 20m. Customer is in trial to paid conversion next week — asking for quick mitigation and a short comms plan.

Emma - CS Ops: On it. Quick questions: (1) Any recent model switches or config pushes for Nexera? (2) Are requests hitting a specific region/pool?

Ravi (SRE): No recent model change in the last 48h for that tenant. Traffic is routed to us-east-1 pool-7. Seeing a sudden influx of small-batch embed requests from their CI job — looks like a test spike. Rate limiter is returning 429s once queue > 500. Tracing attached: trace/1799123456.

Omar (Product): If it's a test job repeatedly hitting with high concurrency, suggest temporary rate-limit bump for the tenant + a short-lived quota exception. Also want to capture exact payload shape to ensure caching not being bypassed.

Lia - CSM: Proposed comms: a) immediate ack to customer that we've identified transient failure in staging, b) confirm mitigation steps and ETA (15–30m), c) offer to rerun onboarding checks once stable, and d) note that prod is unaffected. I'll draft message.

Jake (Support): Mitigation in progress: increased per-tenant concurrent embeds from 10 -> 20 on pool-7 for nexera (temp), and rate limiter threshold raised to 750. Monitoring alert muted for 30m while we observe.

Ravi (SRE): Changes applied at 03:25 UTC. Error rate dropped to 2% within 5m. Retaining for 45m then revert unless Lia requests extension.

Lia - CSM: Draft to send now to Nexera (staging contact): "Hi Ana — quick update: we saw transient embed errors in your staging workspace tied to a CI burst. We've applied a temporary configuration to stabilize staging and are monitoring. Please let us know if you still see failures and we'll rerun onboarding checks. Prod is unaffected. ETA for final rollback: 45m unless you need more time." Thoughts?

Omar (Product): Looks good. Add a line: "If you require a permanent quota increase, we can propose a plan ahead of your conversion."

Lia - CSM: Added. Sending now. @Jake please capture customer sentiment after message, and @Emma mark as follow-up item in renewal playbook if they report friction. :thumbsup:

Jake (Support): Will update thread with customer reply. Thanks all.

Lia - CSM: Follow-up note for CS Ops: add a short checklist to renewal risk docs — include staging flakiness flag, embed error rate >10% during onboarding, and whether mitigation involved quota bump.

Emma - CS Ops: Adding checklist item and linking INC-8792. I'll also schedule a 15m postmortem catch-up with SRE if we revert later.

alert-bot: Incident INC-8792 status -> monitoring (updates: 03:35 UTC, 03:45 UTC)

Jake (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, staging looks stable now. We can continue onboarding. Appreciate the fast response." Closing loop to Lia for renewal note.

Lia - CSM: Marking resolved for now. I'll surface this in the renewal health deck and flag as "transient staging issue, mitigated quickly". If anything changes, re-open the incident.
